newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were quiet Thursday with no sales reported, feedlot sources said.

Active sales Wednesday brought the week's total to nearly 62,000 head, which cleaned up most showlists, sources said. Wednesday's cattle traded from $72.50 to $73.25 per cwt on a live basis and $117.00 to $118.00, with a few at $119.00, on a dressed basis, USDA said.
A small amount of this week's sales were shipped Thursday, while others may be shipped early next week.
Much of this week's sales were sold 15 to 25 days ahead of schedule.
